name: Cold Hearts
source: Cold Hearts is a visual novel about refrigerators, loneliness and the meaning of life. Befriend and date household appliances, melt their frozen hearts, solve the crime story and uncover the truth - the real reason why these girl-fridges made contact with you, of all people!
